# Indigo Software

> Custom ERP & CRM development using PHP & MySQL. Delivering functional live demos built with your data before any commitment.

## Core Services

- [Custom ERP Development](https://indigosoftware.online/#services): Tailored enterprise resource planning solutions designed for specific business workflows.
- [Custom CRM Development](https://indigosoftware.online/#services): Specialized customer relationship management systems for tracking clients, leads, and operational communications.
- [Database Systems](https://indigosoftware.online/#stack): Performant backend system architecture built on PHP and MySQL.

## Primary Industries Served

- [NGOs & Non-Profits](https://indigosoftware.online/#industries): Project tracking, donor management, and custom reporting.
- [Schools & Colleges](https://indigosoftware.online/#industries): Student records, fee management, attendance, and administrative portals.
- [Restaurants](https://indigosoftware.online/#industries): Order management, inventory tracking, and POS integrations.
- [Super Markets](https://indigosoftware.online/#industries): High-volume retail checkout systems and stock control.
